claim: *Model classes overlap.* The same lease state supports ownership, behavioral, and measurement questions. The classes distinguish purpose, not storage objects.

topology.description: Shared represented lease state supports three equal purpose views; no hierarchy of model classes.

required_terms: Shared lease state owner · epoch · lifetime
One represented state, several engineering questions.
bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: A shared lease state containing owner, epoch and lifetime branches to three peer views: ownership asks who owns it, behavior asks when it is stale and measurement asks how many are active. The same represented state supports distinct engineering purposes. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
